scenario.name: Packet loss on WAN circuit
scenario.description: The New York WAN circuit degrades with CRC errors, packet loss and high latency.

incident.title: New York users report slow applications and choppy calls
incident.description: Users in New York report that ERP pages load slowly and voice calls drop intermittently.

ground_truth.root_cause: Physical degradation on Carrier A circuit WAN-NYC-0001 causes CRC errors, about 11% packet loss and roughly 85 ms of additional latency on LNK-WAN-NYC.
